title: Non-linear overlay ad on a linearity-2 video slot exposes a MediaFile false positive

source.name: IAB VAST_Samples repository — VAST 4.2 Samples/Inline_Non-Linear_Tag-test.xml
source.license: IAB Tech Lab VAST_Samples repository; the repository LICENSE.txt is a disclaimer only, granting no explicit reuse right (see video-audio:va-sample-license) — treated as reference-only, structure/tag-set informed the fixture; all text content and hosts rewritten as original test data (MIT)
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All tracking, static-resource and click hosts rewritten to *.example.test, namespaced to this case id.

AdSystem text 'iabtechlab' replaced with 'ortbtools test fixture'; AdTitle set to this case's id; Description replaced with a short fixture sentence (the sample's Description was authoring instructions to sample consumers, not ad content).
Extension total_available changed from the sample's 2 to 1 and Pricing changed from 25.00 to 3.00 (matching bid.price); these are the only content-value edits beyond hosts and labels.

The OpenRTB 2.6 BidRequest/BidResponse envelope and imp.video.linearity=2 (Non-Linear/Overlay) are original test data; the NonLinearAds/StaticResource tag names and nesting are otherwise unmodified from the IAB sample.
Request/response IDs and impid are intentionally paired.
No real person, cookie, advertising ID, IP address or live tracking endpoint is retained.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: Use x-openrtb-version: 2.6 when replaying HTTP; envelope itself has no version field.

specNotes: imp.video.linearity=2 requests a non-linear/overlay creative (OpenRTB 2.6 List: Video Linearity); the returned VAST InLine ad answers with only <NonLinearAds><NonLinear><StaticResource> — a complete VAST 4.4 §3.12 non-linear ad with no <Linear> creative and therefore no <MediaFile>.

VAST §3.9 <MediaFile> is a child of <Linear>; §3.12 requires only that InLine provide at least one of <Linear> or <NonLinearAds>. This document is spec-valid, but packages/core/rules-vast.js:133-136 checks for a <MediaFile> tag anywhere in the document whenever <InLine> is present, so it misreports vast.mediafile_missing on this valid non-linear-only ad — see knownGap DEF-130.
bid.w/h (350x350) describe the NonLinear creative's own pixel size, not the main video canvas (640x360).
Validity describes protocol structure and declared constraints; generated media bytes must be checked against declared MIME/duration before playback tests.
Current Inspector contract displays VAST as inert XML; text visibility must not be counted as creative rendering or media playback.
fixtureAssets lists controlled resources; intercept .test URLs locally. Never fetch public advertising/tracking hosts.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

preview.capabilityGap: The current VAST preview is inert XML; video/audio playback and Wrapper resolution are not implemented.

knownGap.note: MediaFile is a Linear-creative element (VAST §3.9); an InLine ad delivering only NonLinearAds must not be flagged for a missing MediaFile.
